annotatedSteps.description: State the Basic Proportionality Theorem ratio
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: × Incorrect ratio for BPT; it should be AD/DB = AE/EC (or AD/AB = AE/AC).
× Incorrect value due to evaluating an incorrect ratio.

teacherNote: Marked against: Stating the correct Basic Proportionality Theorem ratio (AD/DB = AE/EC or AD/AB = AE/AC) (1); Substituting the given values into the correct ratio (1); Solving for EC to get EC = 6 cm (1). Basic Proportionality Theorem states that AD/DB = AE/EC, not AD/AB = AE/EC. Using the correct ratio yields 2/3 = 4/EC, giving EC = 6 cm.
